limitations.note: The patch fixed the counter’s handshake condition but also removed the `ready_b` requirement for starting a fresh sum, changing `data_out` when the first input of a group is accepted while downstream is not ready.

The scoreboard assumed an unconditional fresh sum for each group and checked `data_out` only when a result was pending, so it validated the new behavior rather than detecting the change to the original `ready_b`-dependent accumulation.
